verdicts.reason: A breaks the design: the three small crosses are blown up into huge, blurry white bars across the face, the cloud shapes are stretched into a disjointed white blob over the image, and the quote is crammed into a bottom box with 'MAHATMA GANDHI' moved beside it as a competing column. B keeps the original composition, crosses and type intact, but it is basically a scaled copy with black side bars and the cloud band not reaching the canvas edges (with a strip of photo showing at the left and right), so it needs edge cleanup before it could ship.
